items.prompt: Why store indexes in the sliding maximum deque?

options.text: Indexes convert every comparison into an authentication check
Only indexes can represent a nonnegative number
options.why: Values can also be nonnegative; that is not the reason.

options.text: The full input event log must always be kept in the deque
They identify which candidates have left the current window
options.why: Expiry is about position/age, not just value.

items.explanation: Value order identifies dominance; positions identify expiration. The candidate deque stores only potentially winning entries.
